svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Rounded $0 Local logo, v3
svg.desc: The Gentle Ticket variant from v2 continues with a proper Arial Bold $0. The capsule end, right-facing tag point, and attached local pin-base preserve its softer character. Paired with the exact Free-Stuff-Near-You name in deep green. Original, unadopted concept with editable text and transparent surroundings.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif
